verdict.rationale: Undermind's enterprise page documents that an organization can request complete removal of its data at any time, which is a first-party deletion capability. It appears to be an on-request, org-level process rather than self-serve control, and nothing documents retention settings. missing for 10: configurable retention periods, self-serve per-item or per-user deletion controls, availability outside enterprise plans, detailed retention/deletion policy docs, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: Request complete removal of your organization's data at any time.
